sgtconti_raindrop_refract.name: Raindrop Refraction
sgtconti_raindrop_refract.description: Procedural rain on glass. The window fogs with condensation and running drops wipe it clear, each bead its own lens with its own refractive power and fall speed. Optional static dew. Supports WebGL and WebGPU.

size.name: Size
size.desc: Approximate drop cell size in pixels.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: Fall speed multiplier. Sets the speed of the fastest drops.

randomMag.name: Randomness
randomMag.desc: Random position jitter and wobble amount.

windX.name: Wind X
windX.desc: Horizontal wind drift in pixels per second.

strength.name: Strength
strength.desc: How much of the refracted image shows through each drop. Does not change the lens itself, so drops stay properly lens-like at every setting.

blurLod.name: Blur LOD
blurLod.desc: Texture LOD used for the refracted sample in WebGPU.

variation.name: Drop Variation
variation.desc: Natural variation in bead size, roundness and vertical pear-shaped runners. Optical variation between drops is always on.

smear.name: Smear
smear.desc: Amount and reach of soft, gravity-aligned wet tracks behind moving drops. Slower drops trail less.

speedVar.name: Speed variation
speedVar.desc: Spread of individual drop fall speeds. Drops vary downwards from Speed, never above it. 0 makes every drop fall at the same rate.

fog.name: Fog
fog.desc: Condensation haze on the glass. The view is blurred everywhere except where drops sit or have run, so tracks read as clear channels. 0 disables the blur entirely and costs nothing.

dew.name: Dew
dew.desc: Static condensation beads clinging to the glass. They do not fall, carry no tracks, and hold their own patch clear of the fog.
